## Undead Emu (CR 1)

The following creature was created by applying the Zombie template to the emu created by Spes Magna Games.  

**XP** 400  
NE Medium undead  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision; **Perception** +9  


**Defense**


**AC** 14, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 natural)  
**hp** 24 (3d8)  
**Fort** +1, **Ref** +3, **Will** +3  
**Defensive Abilities** DR 5/slashing; **Immune** undead traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** slam +3 (1d6+1)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 13, **Dex** 14, Con—, Int—, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 15  
**Feats** Toughness  
**SQ** staggered  


**Special Abilities**


**Staggered (Ex)** Zombies have poor reflexes and can only perform a single move action or standard action each round. A zombie can move up to its speed and attack in the same round as a charge action.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** any  
**Treasure** none
